edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Free jazz in the alley Thursday, a blues guitarist in Walhalla Friday, a country Saturday, brewery music both nights — and the lake in between.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution — free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, every week through October. The happy-hour set starts at 5:30, the main act at 6:30. Get dinner downtown and let the weekend start a day early.
events.note: Free · 6:30–9pm (happy hour 5:30) · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: Ally Venable Band at WPAC
events.body: Texas blues-rock guitar in the old Walhalla auditorium — a big-room show twenty minutes from the water. Doors at the Performing Arts Center, show at 7:30pm.

events.title: Jocassee Family Adventure Camp
events.body: The every-Friday, all-ages tour of waterfalls, swimming holes, and salamander habitat that makes the ride home interesting. Limited seats.
events.note: Adults $75 · Ages 4–15 $70 · Park entry separate — confirm with the operator

events.title: Corey Smith — Southern Drawl Tour
events.body: Georgia country singer-songwriter at the Walhalla Performing Arts Center. If your lake day ends early, this is the Saturday night.

events.title: Live music at both lake breweries
events.body: Keowee Brewing in Seneca has free live music every Friday and Saturday. Over in Salem, Jocassee Valley Brewing has West End Strings Friday and Freddie Vanderford Blues Saturday, plus food trucks both nights.

plan.title: Boat day, blues night
plan.body: Afternoon on Keowee, dinner in Seneca, then either the Ally Venable ticket in Walhalla or the free stage at Keowee Brewing.
plan.label: Grab Friday tickets ↗

plan.title: Jocassee before the gate line
plan.body: Devils Fork early, clear water all morning, then Jocassee Valley Brewing's music and food trucks on the drive home — or clean up for Corey Smith at 7:30.
plan.label: Plan the launch →

plan.title: The slow one
plan.body: Pick a swim beach, get there before the afternoon heat, and let the weekend end on a towel instead of a highway.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
